bassVisual.title: Bass pulse
bassVisual.description: The circle size shows current bass energy. An expanding, fading glow indicates a detected pulse; stronger pulses produce a stronger glow.
bassVisual.notes: Active during live analysis and playback. Higher sensitivity lowers the bass detection threshold in the measurement fields too. Changing sensitivity or spacing resets detection history. These are pulses at 20–250 Hz, not verified kick drum recognition. Animated glows are disabled when your system requests reduced motion.

liveAnalysis.title: Live analysis
liveAnalysis.description: Current measurements of the playing track in separate fields, refreshed approximately every 100 ms. No full-file analysis is required.
liveAnalysis.failed: Live analysis could not start. Check Web Audio support in your browser and try again.
liveAnalysis.lastBassStrength: Last bass pulse strength relative to threshold
liveAnalysis.lastOnsetStrength: Last energy increase strength relative to threshold
liveAnalysis.notes: Fields refresh approximately every 100 ms with a 93 ms measurement window. Attacks are detected separately approximately every 20 ms, using a shorter 23 ms window and filtered bass. Glows react immediately; ringing is grouped into one event. Seeking resets history. The browser can delay reads, especially in the background. Tempo requires regular pulses; bars are not inferred. Stopping analysis does not stop playback.

analysis.title: Audio analysis
analysis.description: Analyze the entire recording without playback. Results are computed in your browser and remain available until you leave this page. Click a track title in the Library to open its analysis.
analysis.limits: First version: MP3/WAV, up to 50 MiB and 10 minutes, mono or stereo. Parameters every 100 ms; frequency analysis window approximately 93 ms. Band energy is a percentage of energy between 20 and 20,000 Hz. RMS and Peak measure digital signal levels, not LUFS.
analysis.unsupported: This browser does not support audio analysis.
analysis.limit: The file exceeds analysis limits: 50 MiB, 10 minutes, mono/stereo or the memory budget.
analysis.denied: You do not have access to this recording.
analysis.missing: This recording is no longer available.
analysis.noAudio: This track has no audio file.
analysis.estimates: A bass pulse is an energy increase at 20–250 Hz, not instrument recognition. Tempo is based on pulse regularity and may be half or twice the musical BPM. Beats, meter and bars are not inferred yet. Strength is the increase relative to the detection threshold, not confidence.
analysis.empty: No events detected. Signal parameters are available in the other view.
